contentList.content: Ki Warrior

Ki Warriors Warriors have mastered the use of Ki to a degree most fighters or even monks could only wish. Able to easily concentrate their ki in and around their body, Ki Warriors can fire blasts land strikes at blinding speeds and even learn to fly using nothing but the power of their Ki.
Saiyan Heritage

You have the blood of an ancient alien race coursing through your veins. Thanks to it, you are stronger, faster, but far more prideful than any lesser race. You are a saiyan, and you will show them who is the true strongest warrior in the land.
Turtle Hermit Prodigy

Through blood, sweat and tears you have pushed past your limits time and time before. Shaping yourself to be a ki warrior often deemed supernatural in sheer might and power. Through nothing but dedication and training, you will surpass every challenge that comes your way.
Warrior's Ki
A measure of your energy and capacity to fight. You normally recover 10% of your maximum Ki at the start of each of your turns. You automatically regain all Ki after combat ends.
Zenkai

Your capacity to bounce back from death as a Saiyan.
Whenever you would become Downed in combat, you can choose to instead instantly regain 25% of your Hit Points and gain Zenkai Boost for the rest of the combat encounter.
Senzu Bean
A miraculous seed that fully restores the body of all wounds and ailments. They grow quickly, but have a low yield.
You're not meant to see this headass.
Martial Arts: Rapid Blows

After making an attack with a <LSTag Tooltip="MonkWeapon">Monk Weapon</LSTag> or while unarmed, you can make another unarmed attack as a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">bonus action</LSTag>.
Martial Arts: Agile Blows

Attacks with <LSTag Tooltip="MonkWeapon">Monk Weapons</LSTag> and unarmed attacks deal [1], unless their normal damage is higher and scale with your <LSTag Tooltip="Dexterity">Dexterity</LSTag> instead of your <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> if your Dexterity is higher.
Ki Blast
Charge and fire a ball of concentrated Ki. A Ki Warrior's most reliable attack.
Unarmed Strike
Strong Strike
Deliver two devastating kicks, dealing [1] each.
This technique can also be used as a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">bonus action</LSTag> as part of Martial Arts: Rapid Blows.
Strong Follow-Up Strike
Deliver two devastating kicks, dealing [1] each.
Gather Power
Fleeting Gather Power
Intense Gather Power
Concentrate and gather your power, replenishing your Ki.
Concentrate and gather your power, replenishing [1]% of your Ki.
Challenge
Throw out a challenge to a foe, inviting them to come at you directly as you focus on them.
You are currently challening specific combatants. You have <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> On Attack Rolls against anyone other than those you challenged.
Bukūjutsu
You fly through the use of ki. At your current level of training, you can only spare short bursts of movement.
You fly through the use of ki. Hardly any further than you can run, but you can reach further places thanks to your training.
Afterimage Techique
By utilizing Ki at the very last second, you can potentially avoid damage. You gain the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="KW_Counterattack_A">Counterattack</LSTag> reaction.

When attacked, you can spend a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction</LSTag> to gain a bonus to your <LSTag Tooltip="ArmorClass">Armour Class</LSTag> equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
You fly through the use of ki. Your body has grow used to the feeling of flight and thus can reach further in a single burst.
Improved Ki Control
Your control over ki allows you to regain and additional 5% of your ki each turn.
You fly through the use of ki with extreme ease, requiring little energy or movement.
Skill Expertise: Intimidation
Your defiant and imposing Saiyan nature makes you terrifying to those weaker than you. You gain <LSTag Tooltip="Expertise">Expertise</LSTag> in the Intimidation Skill.
Zenkai (1/Day)

As a saiyan, death is but a chance to grow stronger. Whenever you would become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DOWNED">Downed</LSTag> in combat, you can choose to instead instantly regain 25% of your Hit Points and gain <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KW_Zenkai_Boost">Zenkai Boost</LSTag> for the rest of the combat encounter.
Zenkai Boost

Being brought to the brink only makes you stronger. Your <LSTag Tooltip="ArmorClass">Armour Class</LSTag> increases by [1] and you have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag>on all <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.
Indominable
Your saiyan spirit cannot be stopped. Each time you spend an action to regain Ki, you gain Temporary Hit Points.
Counterattack

Your defiant saiyan nature allows you to remain at the offensive even while others are attempting to attack you. You gain the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="KW_Counterattack_A">Counterattack</LSTag> reaction.

When attacked by by a melee strike, you can spend a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction</LSTag> to make an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against your attacker.
Zenkai (2/Day)
Zenkai (3/Day)
Skill Expertise: Persuasion
You know that the path to growth is not a solitary one. You gain <LSTag Tooltip="Expertise">Expertise</LSTag> in Persuasion.
Lend Energy
Lend some of your Ki to an ally, granting them an additional <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">bonus action</LSTag> for a turn.
Energy Surge
You've been lent a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">bonus action</LSTag> from an ally.
Turtle School Training
You've mastered the techniques form the Turtle School. You regain 10 Ki each time you land a critical blow.
Grand Lend Energy
Lend a substantial amount of your Ki to an ally, granting them an additional <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ActionPoint">action</LSTag> for a turn.
You've been lent an <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ActionPoint">action</LSTag> from an ally.
Kaio-Ken Mastery

You've truly mastered the art of Kaio-Ken technique. During Kaio-Ken, all Ki Techniques and attacks with a Monk Weapon or while unarmed inflict Reverberation.
You can withstand up to 10 Stacks of Kaio-Ken Strain before your body gives out.
You have Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws from Kaio-Ken Strain.
You no longer generate Kaio-Ken Strain or take damage from your basic Kaio-Ken x1 technique.
Auto Kaio-Ken
Automatically enter <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KW_Kaiokenx1">Kaioken x1</LSTag> at the start of combat without spending any actions.
Senzu Beans

You are able to harvest a single <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="KW_SenzuBeanCharge">Senzu Bean</LSTag> after a <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">Long Rest</LSTag>. Any beans you did not use the previous day wither away.
Senzu Bean
Fully restore the target's Hit Points and remove most conditions.

You are able to harvest two <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="KW_SenzuBeanCharge">Senzu Beans</LSTag> after a <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">Long Rest</LSTag>. Any beans you did not use the previous day wither away.
Improved Kaio-Ken Mastery
Your mastery of Kaio-Ken extends to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KW_Kaiokenx2">Kaioken x2</LSTag>.
Kaio-Ken: Power Down
End your Kaio-Ken technique.
Kaio-Ken
Kaio-Ken x2
Kaio-Ken x3
Kaio-Ken x4
Kaio-Ken x5
Kaio-Ken x10
Kaio-ken Strain
Your body is being pushed past its limits. Gaining more than 5 stacks of Kaio-ken Strain causes your body to give out, dealing [2] and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="STUNNED">stunning</LSTag> you.
Change your Kaio-Ken multiplier. You can only do this once per turn.
Through masterful Ki Control, you can push your body past its limits for a short burst. But at the expense of potentially destroying you from the inside out.

Through masterful Ki Control, you can push your body past its limits for a short burst. But at the expense of potentially destroying you from the inside out.
All Ki Techniques and attacks with a Monk Weapon or while unarmed have Advantage, deal an additional [1]. Your critical hit threshold is lowered by [2]. You regain [3] Ki every turn.
Each turn you take [1] and gain [4] Stack(s) of Kaio-Ken Strain.
Super Saiyan: Power Down
End your Super Saiyan transformation.
Super Saiyan
Super Saiyan 2
Super Saiyan 3
Step up or down the Super Saiyan transformation line.
By tapping into your heritage, you can reach a new frontier of power and endurance. Using nothing but Ki to empower yourself to heights unseen.

By tapping into your heritage, you can reach a new frontier of power and endurance. Using nothing but Ki to empower yourself to heights unseen.
All Ki Techniques and attacks with a Monk Weapon or while unarmed have Advantage, deal an additional [1]. You gain a bonus to your Armour Class equal to your Charisma Modifier (Minimum +1) and recoverr [2] at the start of each turn.
You no longer recover Ki passively at the start of your turn, even while using techniques like Kaio-Ken. Instead, you lose [3] Ki at the start of every turn. If you cannot pay this cost, your Super Saiyan state ends.
You can only use this action once every [1] rounds.
Brace

Protect yourself from non-critical incoming damage, gaining <LSTag Tooltip="Resistance">Resistance</LSTag> to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage. But you become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RESTRAINED">unable to move</LSTag> for a turn.
Brace Cooldown
You cannot use the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="KW_Brace">Brace</LSTag> action.
Destructo Disk

Transform a sphere of ki into a thin rotating disk that can cut through flesh, dealing Slashing and Radiant damage as well as inflicting deep <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLEEDING">Bleeding</LSTag> wounds.
Double Sunday
Fire two quick ki beams which leave the target off-balance.
Kamehameha
The signature technique of the turtle school. Fires off a beam of concentrated ki that inflicts serius damage.
Kamehameha Cooldown
You cannot use the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="KW_Kamehameha">Kamehameha</LSTag> action.
Ki Rejuvenation
A namekian technique that uses Ki to mend physical harm. Restores the target's Hit Points.
A creature can only be healed by this action once per <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">Short Rest</LSTag>.
Portable Capsule Corp Animal Translator
A wondrous device that is powered by your Ki and helps you understand animals.
Solar Flare
Channel ki into your forehead and have it explode in a burst of light so bright it <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLINDED">Blinds</LSTag> enemies for 3 turns.
The target is only <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLINDED">Blinded</LSTag> for 1 round.
Solar Flare Cooldown
You cannot use the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="KW_SolarFlare">Solar Flare</LSTag> action.
Special Beam Cannon

Concentrate your Ki into your finger tips and unleash a piercing beam of energy that deals high damage. Enemies who fail their Save are left with a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="GAPING_WOUND">Gaping Wounds</LSTag> for 2 rounds. This technique bypasses Piercing resistance and immunity.

Concentrate your Ki into your finger tips and unleash a piercing beam of energy that deals high damage. Enemies who fail their Save are left with a Gaping Wound for 2 rounds. This technique bypasses Piercing resistance and immunity.
Special Beam Cannon Cooldown
You cannot use the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="KW_SpecialBeamCannon">Special Beam Cannon</LSTag> action.
Targets still take half damage and no status conditions.
Spirit Ball
A weak but highly maneuverable ball of ki that can maneuver around obstacles. It never misses.
Tornado Kick
Deliver wild kicking sweep around you, dealing [1] and potentially knocking opponents <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">Prone</LSTag> even if kick misses.
Uppercut
Deliver a decisive blow to the enemy's chin. Dealing [1] and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SILENCED">Silencing</LSTag> them.
Uppercut Cooldown
You cannot use the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="KW_Uppercut">Uppercut</LSTag> action.
Wolf Fang Fist
Strike, dealing [1] and shoving your foes back in an attempt to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DISARM">Disarm</LSTag> them.
Disarm attempt occurrs even on a failed melee attack.
Sense Ki
Attempt to pierce through the veils of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SG_Invisible">Invisibility</LSTag> by sensing the Ki of all creatures in an area.
The creature remains Invisible.
Multiform
Through careful projection of your Ki, you can create illusory copies which can confuse foes. But only once.
Big Bang Attack
Concentrate Ki into a powerful explosive ball before launching it forward. The blast is so intense it pushes enemies back.
The target takes half damage and is not pushed back.
Big Bang Attack Cooldown
You cannot use the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="KW_BigBangAttack">Big Bang Attack</LSTag> action.
Galick Gun
A furiously devastating beam of energy that ignores Thunder Resistance and Immunity. The beam has a chance of pushing back foes and knocking them Prone.
Deals half damage and does not push the creature or knock them prone.
Galick Gun Cooldown
You cannot use the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="KW_GalickGun">Galick Gun</LSTag> action.
Heat Phalanx
Transform your ki into pure thermal energy, delivering a searing punch that deals [1] plus [2] and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BURNING">Burns</LSTag> foes.
Limit Breaker

Temporarily surpass your limits and achieve greater power, causing all of your attacks do deal maximum damage. But you become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="STUNNED">stunned</LSTag> from the recoil afterwards.
All damage is maximized.
Guided Masenko
A beam of concentrated ki so swift it can only be resisted, not dodged. A failed save cause the foe to be Dazed.
Target takes half damage and no Status effects.
Mask Ki
Lower your Ki enough to make yourself invisible to the naked eye.
Meteor Combo
Rush forward, delivering a single strike dealing [1] and opening up the target for 3 more attacks.
Finish the combo, doing 3 attacks which deal [1] each.
Meteor Combo Cooldown
You cannot use the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="KW_MeteorCombo">Meteor Combo</LSTag> action.
Rapid Fire Ki Wave
Unleash a barrage of rapid, but weak ki blasts.
Rapid Fire Ki Wave Cooldown
You cannot use the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="KW_RapidFireKiWave">Rapid Fire Ki Wave</LSTag> action.
Relentless Pursuit
When successfully landing a non-killing unarmed attack, you can spend a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction</LSTag> to attack the same target again.
Relentless Pursuit Cooldown
You cannot use the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="KW_RelentlessPursuit">Relentless Pursuit</LSTag> reaction.
Sucker Punch
Hit your opponent in the stomach, dealing [1] and dazing them. Disrupts Concentration on a critical hit.
Spirit Bomb

Raising your arms, you begin to slowly channel both your energy and the energy of every living being into a powerful sphere. It is not very strong on its own, but you can spend additional actions to add [1] to the attack. If you do not spend an action charging or throwing the Spirit Bomb, the technique fails.
Targets still take half damage from the explosion.
Channel Spirit Bomb
Pour additional energy into your Spirit Bomb, increasing its damage by [1].
Throw Spirit Bomb
Launch the Spirit Bomb, dealing [1] damage to only your enemies.
You are charging a spirit bomb.
Instant Transmission
Use a large amount of ki to instantly teleport to another person's location.
Dragon Fist

Rush forward with the power of a dragon, dealing [1] plus [2]. This attack is always a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> and ignores <LSTag Tooltip="Resistance">Resistances</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunities</LSTag>.
Dragon Fist Cooldown
You cannot use the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="KW_DragonFist">Dragon Fist</LSTag> action.
Evil Containment Wave

You attempt to use the ultimate sealing sealing technique, trapping the soul of your opponent before letting it fizzle away, instantly killing them. This technique can only be attempted once per target and fails level is lower than the target's. You can only attempt this technique on someone once.
Explosive Wave
Bottle up all your ki inside yourself and unleash it as an explosion around yourself. Demolishing your foes while also Pushing, knocking Prone and dazing all who fail their Saving Throw.
Targets only take half damage and are not pushed back, knocked prone or dazed.
Explosive Wave Cooldown
You cannot use the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="KW_ExplosiveWave">Explosive Wave</LSTag> action.
Project Ki
Throw out your Ki, causing those of weak heart to shiver in fear.
Project Ki Cooldown
You cannot use the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="KW_ProjectKi">Project Ki</LSTag> action.
Final Flash
Unleash a flash of crackling Ki that shocks all who fail their saving throw.
Targets take half damage and are not shocked.
Final Flash Cooldown
You cannot use the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="KW_FinalFlash">Final Flash</LSTag> action.
